question: Norman Ernest Borlaug was awarded the _____ in 1970 for his contributions to the green revolution.
solution:
The Correct is Answer** Nobel Peace Prize**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Borlaug's work in developing high-yielding varieties of wheat and other grains significantly increased agricultural production, helping to alleviate hunger and poverty in many countries.
 
• His contributions to global food security were recognized with the **Nobel Peace Prize in 1970**.
 
• Borlaug is often referred to as the "**Father of the Green Revolution**" due to his pioneering efforts in agricultural research and development.
 
• His work has had a lasting impact on the world's food supply and has saved countless lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **M.S. Swaminathan:** An Indian agricultural scientist who played a crucial role in the Green Revolution in India.
 
• **Indira Gandhi:** The Prime Minister of India during the Green Revolution, who provided political and financial support for agricultural development.
 
• **Robert McNamara:** The President of the World Bank during the Green Revolution, who helped to finance agricultural development projects in developing countries.
